summary: Re-tested the fixes from iteration_122 plus the new Quick IVR 'Resume last draft' feature. Backend: needCalendar lockout fix, 4/4 pytest pass. Frontend: all 6 items pass at 1920 and 390 widths. Item 1: Ava with booking.enabled=true in the DB and no calendar connected shows the booking toggle OFF and disabled; saving a greeting edit gives PUT 200 and the 'Agent saved' toast; turning booking from off to on still returns 400 calendar_not_connected. Item 2: SIP credential cards and guide boxes have 12-16px gaps and no cards touch. Bob sees sip-page-locked with no credential text. Item 3: mobile-channel-link has href https://t.me/CloudIVRNET and target _blank, and the More menu layout is fine. Item 4: Alice and Bob do not get the channel card. A fresh account gets it, dismissing it survives a reload, the key is civr.channelCard.<id>, and a second fresh account in the same browser still sees it. Item 5: the draft banner shows after leaving the page (in-app navigation) and after a reload. Resume restores the numbers, script and OTP mode, shows the 'Draft restored' toast and hides the banner. Discard removes the draft and it stays gone after a reload. A preview POST /calls/quick (202) clears the draft. Bob does not see Alice's draft. The FR and ES banner texts and the toast are translated. Item 6: the record toggle switches both ways, the Quick IVR side panels (presets, recent calls with redial, key-press stats) render, and the dashboard coupon banner renders.

ui_bugs.issue: Unknown app paths such as /cloudivr/app/quick (the real route is /app/quick-call) show the shell with an empty content area. There is no 404 or redirect. Pre-existing and minor.

action_items: Optional: add a catch-all route under /cloudivr/app/* that shows a not-found state or redirects to the dashboard.
Optional: clear civr.quickDraft.* from localStorage on logout. The draft holds phone numbers and stays in the browser after sign-out, which matters on shared devices.
critical_code_review_comments: Draft.js: as soon as the user types into a fresh form without pressing Resume, the banner hides and the old draft is overwritten with the new input. This is reasonable but undocumented, and the old draft is lost without a prompt.

AgentForm save sends booking.enabled=true when the stored value is true, even though the toggle shows OFF because no calendar is connected. needCalendar allows this on purpose. Expected behavior, noted for clarity.
The draft banner strings are hardcoded in English and translated by the DOM i18n engine. This works for FR and ES (verified).
seed_data_creation: Created fresh QA accounts test_qa_ch1_1792844005@example.com and test_qa_ch2_1792844005@example.com (password QaTest#2026xx) in the webAccounts collection. Placed one preview (dry-run) Quick IVR call for Alice to +14155550100; it now appears in Recent calls. Ava's booking.enabled was restored to false, greeting restored to '' and record to true.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The Quick IVR route is /cloudivr/app/quick-call, not /app/quick. The language switcher [data-testid=topbar-lang-switcher] is a native <select>, so use select_option('fr'/'es'). The AI agents collection is aiAgents in DB 'test'. GET /api/cloudivr-web/calendar returns the calendar status. Every browser_automation run is a fresh context, so localStorage drafts must be created in the same run.
